expected_response.decision_rule: Choose an edit only when evidence provides a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective; otherwise retain.
expected_response.primary_evidence: endpoint_effects:9-11 (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5) and endpoint_effects:3-4 (shape_yy/shape_xx) are the strongest signed contrasts but are not expressible by the executing pointcloud scalar
expected_response.secondary_evidence: endpoint_effects:0-2 and branch_adjusted:0-2,77-79,154-156 (null centroid); endpoint_effects:14-16,20-22,32-34,68-70 (heterogeneous landmark signs); branch_adjusted:74-76,151-153,228-230,305-307 (diagnostic joint-motion); continuous:0-19 and curve_support (time-conditioned contrasts, no accepted polynomial)

failure_modes: Pair-kernel and shape-tensor contrasts are diagnostic only; the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so no permitted edit can express them.
Centroid contrasts are null and not reproducible, so a centroid-directed edit would be unsupported.
Landmark softmin and occupancy signs are heterogeneous across landmarks, so a single region_index edit would not follow a consistent direction.

Continuous contrast curves are observed-node interpolations with multiple sign changes and no accepted polynomial fit, so a temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit is not supported by a validated absolute target.
Teacher modes are static last-learning-node forecasts with immutable temperatures, so teacher_neighbors changes are not justified by the supplied provenance.
Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity, so survival evidence cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

parameter_origins.pointcloud_delta_A: incumbent default 1.0 A; executing curvature per formula_registry

rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible signed contrasts are on short-range pair-kernel shell densities (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5, endpoint_effects:9-11, q 1.5e-4 to 9.8e-5, positive batch fraction 1.0) and on shape_yy/shape_xx (endpoint_effects:3-4), but the executing pointcloud scalar is R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau) with q the Hungarian mean squared endpoint distance; it contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit). No permitted edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express a pair-kernel or shape-tensor contrast, so the strongest evidence cannot be connected to an operative reward edit. The remaining permitted levers are not defensibly supported: centroid contrasts are null (endpoint_effects:0-2; branch_adjusted:0-2,77-79,154-156), landmark softmin/occupancy signs are heterogeneous across landmarks (endpoint_effects:14-16,20-22,32-34,68-70), joint-motion contrasts are diagnostic only with no joint term in the scalar (branch_adjusted:74-76,151-153,228-230,305-307), and the continuous contrast curves are observed-node interpolations with multiple sign changes and no accepted polynomial fit (continuous:0-19, curve_support), so a time-conditioned teacher blend or temporal region index is not supported by a validated absolute target. Teacher provenance is static last-learning-node forecasts with immutable temperatures (teacher_modes, fixed_parameters), and the information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092) and top4_teacher_overlap 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515) with 14 independent batches, so narrowing or broadening teacher neighborhoods is not justified. Because no permitted edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a reproducible signed contrast on an observable the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains (Hungarian endpoint distance q or its curvature delta), or a validated absolute time-conditioned target rather than a contrast curve.
